sources.title: nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Description Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-BF16 is a large language model (LLM) trained by NVIDIA, designed to deliver strong agentic, reasoning, and conversational capabilities. It is optimized for collaborative agents and high-volume workloads such as IT ticket automation.

sources.title: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-FP8 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model was trained for approximately 25 trillion tokens. The post-training corpus for NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-FP8 of high-quality curated and synthetically-generated data. Primary languages used for post-training include English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Spanish, and Chinese.

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super
sources.snippet: We are releasing NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super, a 12B active 120B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts hybrid Mamba-Transformer model. Nemotron 3 Super is the first model in the Nemotron 3 series that leverages Latent MoE, includes MTP Layers, and was pre-trained in NVFP4.

sources.title: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-NVFP4 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We also include a small portion of question-answering, and alignment style data to improve model accuracy. The model was trained for approximately 25 trillion tokens.
